messages:
claire: Hi all, second attempt at onboarding. I accepted the org invite earlier but can't access private repos. GH shows 'must enable SSO + 2FA' even though I enabled 2FA minutes ago. The onboarding doc asks me to clone `infra-templates`. Anyone seen this race condition?

onboard-bot: Reminder: Organization enforces SAML SSO and 2FA. If you recently changed security settings, re-authorize the org from your profile and wait a bit for team sync. https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso :information_source: 

raul: welcome @claire! did you accept the invite on your work account (claire@redwood.com) or a personal one? also check Settings -> Emails that the address is verified.

claire: accepted using claire@redwood.com. Verified email. I clicked the big 'Authorize' banner on the org page but still get 403 when trying to view private repos.

infra: sometimes the GH UI shows authorized but internal provisioning lags. Can you run `gh auth status` and `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste outputs? I'll trigger a manual sync for your account.

claire: `gh auth status` -> github.com: Logged in as claire@redwood (Session active)
Git operations for github.com: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-templates (permission: none)

infra: thanks. I kicked the sync and added you to the `onboarding` team. Try signing out from the browser and back in, then re-click the SSO authorize link. Also make sure your SSH key is uploaded to your GH account.

claire-laptop: ran `ssh -T git@github.com` -> Hi claire! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.

claire: After signing out/in and re-accepting SSO, I can now see the repo and `git clone` worked. Looks like the account sync was the missing step. Thanks!

raul: great. Short checklist we tell new hires: 1) verify email, 2) enable 2FA, 3) add SSH key, 4) sign out & back in, 5) click org SSO authorize, 6) wait a minute for permission sync. If it still fails ping #new-hires or @infra.

claire: saved — and leaving a note in the onboarding doc about the timing caveat. Appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:
